leeWayHeader.why: Keep LeeWay-owned experience and controls free without misrepresenting external provider requirements.
leeWayHeader.who: Creator, LeeWay Standards, Runtime owners, and application maintainers.
leeWayHeader.how: Prohibit LeeWay paywalls and require truthful external-provider status plus a non-paid LeeWay path where implemented.

externalProviderBoundary.principle: External provider plans, account eligibility, device platform restrictions, and hosting outages must be disclosed accurately and must never be mislabeled as a LeeWay payment requirement.
externalProviderBoundary.fallbackRule: Where a LeeWay-owned alternative exists and is authorized, offer it without a LeeWay payment gate; otherwise report the unavailable boundary plainly.

runtimeAndDeviceBoundary.authorizationRule: Owner authentication, per-device consent, capability grants, Formula, Veritas, receipts, and platform permission remain required and are not monetization controls.

sourceRequirements: No LeeWay-owned client surface may render a payment-required gate for a LeeWay capability.
Runtime errors must preserve the actual external-provider or authorization boundary.
Application manifests and UI policy adapters must distinguish disabled authorization from external-provider availability.
acceptance: Each product surface is tested against a denied grant and an unavailable external provider without displaying a LeeWay paywall.
Production evidence records each external provider dependency separately from LeeWay access.
